page.layout: One page of text, one column of running text at right; marginal notes in the left margin (three notes beside the lines). Running head at top centre.

main_text.p: nus Ioannes se tenuit ut prius, & non luit aliter respondere. Confequen- ter tamen nos cum dictis cofratribus noftris, & alijs de confilio noftro confuluimus, et de comunicato co- filio eorūdem, declarauimus eidem domino Ioanni Oldcaftello quid S. Romana ecclesia, in hac materia se- quens dicta beatorū Augustini, Hi- eron, & Ambrof, ac aliorū sanctorū determinauit, quas determinationes oportet quofcunq; Catholicos ob- seruare, ad quę idem dominus Ioan- nes respondit, quod bene uoluit cre- dere, & obseruare quicquid S. Ec- clesia determinauit, ac quicquid De us uoluit se credere, & obseruare. Sed quod dominus noster Papa, Cardinales, Archiepiscopi, et episco- pi, caeteriqe praelati ecclesiae habe- rent potestatem, talia determinandi noluit ad tunc aliqualiter affirmare. Vnde nos adhuc sibi compatien- tes, sub spe melioris deliberationis, promi-
Sed de scri ptura Dei nullum uer bum.

page.notes: Marginal notes are in the left margin: "Sed de scri ptura Dei nullum uerbum" (beside the line "eron, & Ambrof") and "Foris agni intus lupi rapaces" (beside "noluit ad tunc"). Marks: a pointing hand at the right edge beside "De". Last word of the page is a catchword-like continuation "promi-" (hyphenated, left as printed). Scan is partly shadowed at the edges; some letters uncertain.
